_: What may go out of this repository into github.com/TomasBouda/SoA, and nothing else.
publish.ps1 reads this; a file is published because a rule here names it.
'from' is a folder in this repository, 'to' the folder in the public one, 'files' the
names that may go (not recursive: one rule per folder). Everything else stays here.
The public repository also gets PUBLISHED.md, written by the script: every file it holds and the rule that put it there.

rules.note: The public repository's own front matter.
The website, GitHub Pages serves docs/: the front page, the Arsenal, the page about the game.
The research: architecture.md, cheats.md, TODO.md and the rest.
The tools, this manifest among them.

The catalog pictures are built out of the game's own data and are here by the owner's decision, the same one that put them in the public kit: the launcher is no use without them. The single exception to the rule that only our own work is published, and deliberate.
Our own pictures: frames of the game with the patches at work, the launcher's windows.

forbidden._: Refused whatever the rules say: the shapes the game's own data takes, and anything over the size.
